props.name: density
props.description: Share of cells alive after randomising, 0 to 1.

props.name: defaultSpeed
props.description: Generations per second when the board first renders. The slider changes it after that.

props.name: autoPlay
props.description: Start running on mount. Ignored under reduced motion, where the board waits for Play.

props.name: wrap
props.description: Edges wrap round to the opposite side, so gliders do not die at the border.
